_about: Photograph slots. `npm run images` takes each photo from content/photos/<slot>.(jpg|png|webp) if that file exists (use this for ConsultAxis's own photography or for slots marked `manual`), otherwise downloads `download` once (Wikimedia Commons). It converts to WebP in several widths with ffmpeg into src/assets/img/, so visitors never load anything from a third party. Every photo keeps photographer, licence and source page; the footer prints them. `reviewAlt`: the alt text was written from the file title and must be checked against the downloaded picture.
